title: 3rd Party � Executive Assistant � Claim Rejected � Customer Must Submit
description:
Validates that when an Executive Assistant attempts to submit a flight disruption claim on behalf of a passenger, the system rejects the submission similarly to a Travel Agency.

Prerequisites:
Third-party caller type: Executive Assistant.
